$comment: CANONICAL SOURCE, vendored byte-for-byte alongside big-number.ts into medusa-allegro (src/lib/sync/), medusa-infakt (src/lib/invoicing/) and medusa-marken (src/lib/). Structural test vectors for bigNumberCandidates() - the property shapes only, since a live BigNumber instance (with real valueOf/toString methods) can't round-trip through JSON. Each repo's own test file additionally exercises a real or fake class instance for the valueOf()/toString() paths. Update all three copies together.

cases.name: plain finite number passes through unchanged
garbage string still passes through - validation is the caller's job
raw.value takes priority over numeric when both present
raw_ takes priority over numeric_ when both present
empty array has nothing readable (Array#toString is '', filtered as blank)
object with an unrelated key is not money
raw.value present but not a scalar is skipped, falls through to nothing else
empty string passes through as a candidate unchanged - callers special-case '' as absent before validation, not this function
